verdict.rationale: Jira's own feature pages say users can create custom automations, including 'rules that move work forward', with Rovo AI assisting. They also say automation connects tools like Bitbucket and Slack to any Jira workflow to keep work up to date. These claims cover the core of event-triggered rules, but they are marketing-level only. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the trigger/condition/action rule model and the supported event types, and independent or hands-on corroboration of rule automation.
